llm.reply:
Marfan syndrome is the disease these records concern [1]. The graph did not return phenotypes directly; it returned the gene record NCBIGene:2200, fibrillin 1 [3]. Its MedGen record supplies the clinical features [20].

## Clinical features

MedGen lists these clinical features: Aortic regurgitation [21], Arachnodactyly [22], Astigmatism [23], Ectopia lentis [24], Esotropia [25], Exotropia [26], Pes planus [27], Glaucoma [28], Congestive heart failure [29] and Hypertropia [30].

## Cysteine substitutions

Many of the retrieved variants replace cysteine residues. ClinVar:16422 is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.6920G>C (p.Cys2307Ser) [2]. ClinVar:16425 is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.3746G>C (p.Cys1249Ser) [5]. ClinVar:16426 is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.4987T>C (p.Cys1663Arg) [6]. ClinVar:16428 is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.3350G>A (p.Cys1117Tyr) [8].

## Truncating variants

Several retrieved variants introduce premature stop codons. ClinVar:16424 is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.8268G>A (p.Trp2756Ter) [4]. ClinVar:16430 is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.6339T>G (p.Tyr2113Ter) [10]. ClinVar:16439 is NM_000138.5(FBN1):c.8326C>T (p.Arg2776Ter) [16].

## Unlabelled records

Some variant records carry no name. One of these is ClinVar:16436 [14]. Another is ClinVar:16442 [18].
